definition_used: One or more third parties misunderstood one or more parts of a message sent to and/or from one or more third parties.
caution: The definition describes a communication error involving third parties, but does not specify any impact on research content, authorship, editorial processes, or post-publication oversight. It is a status/notice term indicating a misunderstanding, not a substantive manuscript integrity issue.
semantic_rationale: The definition centers on a third-party communication misunderstanding, which does not directly map to any of the four manuscript-facing categories. It is a procedural notice about information exchange, lacking clear connection to research reliability, attribution, editorial governance, or post-publication due process.
